answer: A network can resist Sybil attacks with a rotating capability exam. Each epoch, every identity draws a fresh practical task from a large bank: one must thread a data pipeline through a new schema, another must keep a service steady at a wharf crowded with requests, and each task must be done before dawn. A jury grades every submission, and no answer can be reused because each draw differs. An attacker running fifty fake agents must genuinely pass fifty distinct exams inside one window, paying fifty shares of real skilled work, while one honest agent passes a single exam and earns normally.
